gloss: people-pleaser; someone who tries to please everyone

definitions.gloss: people-pleaser; someone who tries to please everyone
definitions.explanation: a person who tries to be liked by everyone and avoids taking clear positions, often seen negatively as lacking principles

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{八方美人|はっぽうびじん}だ。
{八方美人|はっぽうびじん}は{信用|しんよう}されない。
{八方美人|はっぽうびじん}な{態度|たいど}をやめるべきだ。
examples.english: You should stop trying to please everyone.

notes:
LITERAL MEANING:
{八方|はっぽう} (eight directions / all directions) + {美人|びじん} (beautiful person)
- "A beauty from every angle" → someone who looks good to everyone.

NUANCE:
Almost always used with negative connotation. It implies someone who lacks genuine conviction and changes their position depending on who they're talking to.

USAGE:
- {八方美人|はっぽうびじん}な{人|ひと} (a people-pleaser)
- {八方美人|はっぽうびじん}な{態度|たいど} (people-pleasing attitude)
- {八方美人|はっぽうびじん}になる (to become a people-pleaser)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {調子者|ちょうしもの} (smooth talker, someone who goes along with others)
- {日和見|ひよりみ} (fence-sitter, opportunist)
